claims: C1 a scope of autonomy can be established by being built into the product design
C2 a scope of autonomy can be established by being dynamically negotiated with the assistant for complex tasks
C3 these two ways are examples, not an exhaustive list, of how a scope can be established

concepts.name: scope_of_autonomy
concepts.gloss: the agreed-upon boundary of the assistant's autonomy, defining which sub-goals it may pursue, acceptable side effects, and when it must pause for clarification or approval

concepts.name: built_into_product_design
concepts.gloss: a scope of autonomy that is established by being built into the product design, such as a coding assistant with understood boundaries around code modification

concepts.name: dynamically_negotiated
concepts.gloss: a scope of autonomy that is established by being dynamically negotiated with the assistant for complex tasks, much like a consulting firm submitting a scope-of-work

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority carried by rules in the #scope_of_autonomy section, as described by the node that defines root_authority
concepts.inference: the node's NEEDS entry states that rules in the #scope_of_autonomy section carry root authority, so this module assumes that meaning for the borrowed predicate
